vertical_datum: approximately mean sea level (GA GBR 30 m model)

derivation.elevation: Resampled (bilinear) from the measured DEM onto this grid; gaps filled by inverse-distance interpolation (rasterio fillnodata) and flagged 0 in measured.png.
derivation.texture: Resampled (area average) from the source imagery onto the same grid. No synthetic pixels.
